best_idea: Re-check a queued action against live world state on every tick, before anything is applied, and stop it with a reason when its conditions, its target or its own rule no longer hold, instead of trusting the state from when it was queued.
decision_why: The per-tick re-check at resolution time is what kills need, but the donor target check is a null test only, the loop runs on the render frame with variable delta, and a stop is a warning log; Frankendom must check fight state at a fixed server tick and return a typed stop reason.
acceptance: A test queues an attack, the target dies from another attacker in the same tick, the next server tick stops the queued attack with TARGET_INVALID, no damage or XP is written to the ledger, and the client receives the stop reason.
